lines.text: Did you know? Form is Latin for shape.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus shape?

words.ex: Please inform us if you change your address.
The students will perform a play at the end of term.
The government announced a reform of the tax system.

publish.title: Form root: inform, perform and reform
publish.value: Form comes from Latin "forma" (shape, form). Words: inform, perform and reform. inform = in + form; perform = per + form; reform = re + form.
